name: Progress MS-19
about: Progress MS-19 (2022-014A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2022 Feb 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2022 Feb 15), held fixed
docked to S36086; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
